content: JISAS PAGWULAA LƗGA WAPUSEPUT SIP SIP KAT MBUTƗNDƗ

Jisas laataa ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk kat woseka ana waigowun. Awuk ngwula. Kɨta nyan sip sip kwaa lɨga tɨvwina suwi yambɨmba wuleivak kat kai walaa tɨvwi saka yiga wuleindeyan wan nyan sɨkwutɨga nyana. Kavle vat yiga yetɨlɨga nyana.
Suwi yambɨ savagu wuleilɨga nyan ndɨ wan tɨvwina sip sip kat vɨga lɨga nyana.

Ndi kat vɨga lɨga nyan yandɨ maa suwi yambɨ kat vɨga lɨga nyan lavwigiyandɨ. Sip sip ndɨna kwundi wuka lɨgandi. Sip sip kɨta kɨta ndina sɨ vɨga wuka lɨgandɨ. Ndɨ yagwa wandɨ maa ndɨna kwundi wutaa ndɨna kwupmba yilɨgandi.
Ndɨna sip sip tɨvwimba lɨga wogwenjeyan ndi avla ana wogwelɨgandi. Ndɨ tak suwi yambɨ wogwelɨgandɨ. Ndi ndɨna kwundi wutaa ndɨna kwupmba wogwelɨgandi.
Kwo nyan kat vɨlaa vaka pɨlɨgiyandi. Kwo nyana kwundi ana wuka lɨgandi waa wandɨ Jisas.
PAGWULAA LƗGA WAPUSEPUTNA ANGWA NYAANGƗT
Wan pagwulaa lɨga wapuseput Jisas mbutndɨ maa wan wapusepuk kat wutaa ana ndi yelavɨka lɨgandi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Nyaangɨt mbupmat yigowun. Awuk ngwula. Wan sip sipna tɨvwina suwi yambɨ wunayɨ.
Wun tɨwun mala tata ya nɨmba ndi sɨkwuka kavle vat tɨgiyandi. Sip sip ndina kwundi ana wuka lɨndi.
Suwi yambɨ wunayɨ. Ndi kat vɨga lɨlɨwun maa ndi apma vat tɨgiyandi. Sip sip apma yuwi kat vlaa kɨlɨnja vla apma vat tɨgiyandi.
Sɨkwutɨga nɨmba apma vat kwutaa yetɨvak kat ana yalɨgandi. Sɨkwupmat, vatnyavat, kavle vat yivat mɨna yelavɨka yalɨgandi. Wun ndinyangu kat njɨmbla njɨmbla apma vat yetɨjeya vak kat kwivat yawun.
Apma vapmba sip sip kat vɨga lɨga nyan vla lɨgowun. Sip sip kat vɨga lɨga nyan vla lɨgowun. Sip sip kat vɨga la nyan sip sip kat tɨga kiyalɨnda vla wuno ndinyangu kat vɨga lɨga kiyaigowun.
Nat kɨta nyan sanya klavat sip sip kat vɨga lɨgiyandɨ. Vɨga lɨnda sip sip kat valɨvat yandeyan ndɨ vaakaa pɨlɨndɨ maa sip si pkat vatnyandɨ maa vɨlaa nat sip sip kava kavat vaaka pɨlɨgiyandi.
Sanya klavat sip sip kat vɨga lɨga nyan ndɨ sip sip kat ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨgandɨ. Ngi kat tɨga ndi kat kwagalalaa pɨlɨndɨ.
Wun wupma ana kwagalalaa vaaka pɨlɨgiyowun. Sip sip kat ama vat vɨga lɨga nyan vla lɨgowun. Wuna nɨmbana sɨ kɨta kɨta vɨga wuka lɨgowun. Dino wun kat vɨga wuka lɨgandi.
Wuno wuna nyaek Godno awat sowat vɨga lɨgali. Wuna sip sip kat tɨga wun kiyaigowun.

Nat mbaapmamba lɨga sip sip ndino wuna sip sip ndi. Ndi kat yiwun wuna kwundi wutaa wuna lak yaigandi. Yandi ma aywaa wuna sip sip kɨta tɨvwimba taagawun maa tɨgiyandi. Ndi kat aywaa wuna lak vɨga lɨgiyowun.
Kiyalaa lɨga laakiyowun waa yelavɨtaa kiyaigowun. Kiyaweya vak kat vɨlaa wuna nyaek wun kat woviyaguga lɨgandɨ.

Kɨta nyan ndɨna maawupmba yelavɨtaa wun kat ana alɨpsɨga vatnyagiyandɨ. Wun wowun maa wun kat vatnygiyandɨ. Kiyalaa lɨga laakiyowun. Vɨga lɨgowun. Kiyalaa lɨga avla laakweya kwondu ngilɨga. Vɨga lɨgowun. Wuna nyaek wunkat wupma wandɨ maa vɨga lɨgowun waa wandɨ Jisas.
Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨk kat wutaa Juda ngambuga lɨga mbaapma vɨlɨlɨk sɨndi.
Nat mbaapmamba la nɨmba wandi. Kavle waagan tavindɨ maa ndɨ tungwengwan yiga lɨgandɨ. Ndɨna kwundi wupmak kat nɨn kai wanɨn waa wandi.
Nat mbaapmamba la nɨmba wandi. Kavle waagan tavilaa lɨlɨga nyan wupma wanda vla ana waigandɨ. Kavle waagan tavilaa lɨlɨga nyan mɨni kiya nyana mɨni ana kwunakiyandɨ waa wandi.
JUDA JISAS KAT KWUNDIMBA NDƗ KAT WALEALƗNDI
Judana nɨma nandinya yandɨ. Wan tamba Godna ngay kwunataa wuleilaa lɨnja njɨmbla yelavɨka lɨnja nɨma nandinya. Yipma yila njɨmbla yelavɨka lɨnja nɨma nandinya. Yipma yila njɨmbla.
Wan njɨmbla Jisas Godna gay wuleilaa tamba la nyan Solomon kwutaw kavamba lɨga yi yalɨndɨ.

Tɨndɨ maa Juda ndɨ kat ya wegwulaa wagalandi. Manda kat nɨn kat kapmba yigumba walapman yimɨn maa nɨna maawut kavle vat yelavɨka lɨganɨn. Mbambala nɨn kat kapmba mbukiyamɨn. Mɨn God wandɨ, yaa nyan mɨn? Mɨn Kraist mɨn? Nɨn kat ambup mɨla waa wandi.

Wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk kat Kraistnat tɨwa vak tamba mbukwun maa wun kat woseka wandɨ waa wangwuk. Wuna nyaek wun kat kwiya njɨvwa kwutɨwun. Wan kwutɨwa njɨvwa Kraistnat tɨwa vat ndinyangu kat vɨsɨmogwilɨgandɨ.
Ngwuk Kraistnat tɨwa vat ana vɨga lɨgangwuk. Ngwuk wuna sip sip ana ngwuk. Ngwuk kat tamba wowun.
Wuna sip sip wuna kwundi wuka lɨgandi. Ndina sɨ kɨta kɨta wuka lɨgowun. Wuna kwundi wutaa wuna kwupmba yalɨgandi.
Ndi kat njɨmbla njɨmbla apma vat tɨnjeya vat kwilɨgowun. Ndi ana kavle yigiyandi. Kɨta nyan ana ndi kat kwutaga alaguat kloga kaligiyandɨ. Wun ndi kat kwutaa lɨgowun.
Wuna nyaek ndi kat kwutaa lɨwangat wandi. Ndɨ njambwi nyana. Nat nyan ndɨ kat ana kwulakiyandɨ. Kɨta nyan ana alɨpsɨga ndi kat kwutaga alaguat kloga kaligiyandɨ. God ndɨno ndi kat kwutaa lɨgandɨ.
Wuna nyaeknonala an kɨta lulu tɨgali. An kɨta vat tɨgali waa wandɨ Jisas.
Jisas wandɨ maa ndɨ kat vatnyavat Juda kambak klalaa yaagi mɨna lɨndi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Wuna nyaek wun kat kwiya apma nɨma njɨvwa nɨma sakwat kwutɨwun. Anda apma njɨvwa kwutɨwa njɨvwa kat vɨlaa wun kat vatnya mɨna lɨgangwuk waa wagalandɨ Jisas.

Wagalandɨ maa Juda ndɨ kat wandi. Kwutɨma apma njɨvwa kat vɨlaa mɨn kat ana vatnya mɨna lɨganɨn. God kat kavle vat wamɨn. Ngwuk ndu ngwuk. Wun God wun waa manda kat apma wamɨn. Wamangat mɨn kat vatnya mɨna lɨganɨn waa wandi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. ngwutna tamba la nyan God waa nyaangɨt wutaa pɨlɨwutndɨ. Ngwuk Godno kɨtamba kɨta lulu lɨgangwuk waa tamba pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Wan tamb la nyan pɨlɨwukna nyan ndinyangu kat ndi God ndi waa pɨlɨwutndɨ. Wan pɨlɨwukna nyan Godna nyaangɨt wutaa God kwiya njɨvwa kwuta nyan ndɨ. Wan pɨlɨwuknda nyaangɨt woseka waa ana pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Wungi kat tɨga wun Godna nyan wun waa wawa vat wutaa ngwut manda kat ndɨ kavle vat wandɨ waa walɨgangwuk. God wun kat ay wandɨ ndɨna vat ndinyangu kat sɨmagavat kan kɨpmat ngaga yawun.
Wuna nyaek God wun kat kwinda njɨvwa kwutapman yiweyan wuna kwundi ana wukiyangwuk.

God kwinda njɨvwa kwutɨgowun. Walɨwa kwundi wupmak kat kai wangweyan kwutɨwa njɨvwa vɨlaa ndɨ God kwiya nyana waa wun kat yelavɨkiyangwuk. Ndɨ Godna kwondumba njɨvwa kwutɨgandɨ maa wun kat yelavɨkiyangwuk. Ndɨnogwi Godno kɨta lulu lɨgambɨt waa yelavɨkɨiyangwuk. Waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ maa ndɨ kat vatnyavat kwupmat wandi. Ndi kat kwagalalaa pagwuga yindɨ.
Ndi kat kwagalalaa Jodan walɨnja ndandangɨ nat naangɨ valɨgendɨ. Wan yinda kava tat Jon ndinyangu kat ngu yagula kava. Wumba yilaa yetɨndɨ.
Wumba lɨndɨ, ndɨ kat nɨma sakwat nɨmba yalɨndi. Yalaa ndɨ kat walɨndi. Jisas kwunatɨnda nɨma njɨvwa Jon wupma ana kwutɨndɨ. Jon ndɨ kat wanda nyangɨt woseka ana walɨndɨ waa walɨndi.
Wan kava la nɨma sakwat nɨmba Jisas kat vɨlaa God wandɨ maa yaa nyana waa walɨndi.
